description: AI Smart Speaker — real-time operational metrics

panels.title: Wake Word Detections
panels.description: Wake word triggers by context: idle = normal wake, barge_in = interrupting AI response, re_listen = re-triggered while already listening

panels.title: False Triggers
panels.description: initial_silence = no speech detected after wake word; stt_rejection = STT verifier rejected the audio

panels.title: API Sessions
panels.description: Sessions opened vs. closed by reason (max_turns = normal limit reached, inactivity = timed out, false_trigger = wake word was false positive)

panels.title: Conversation Activity
panels.description: Turns completed, follow-ups started and timed out, barge-ins executed

panels.title: State Transitions
panels.description: Rate of state machine transitions — useful for spotting unexpected cycling or stuck states

panels.title: Radio Plays by Source
panels.description: ai_new = voice command with station name, ai_resume = voice command to resume, mqtt_power = MQTT ON command, mqtt_station = MQTT station switch

panels.title: Radio Stops & Volume Ducks
panels.description: Radio stop commands by source and volume duck/unduck events (one duck per wake word when radio is playing)

panels.title: Station Play Counts
panels.description: Total play count per station (persisted across app restarts)

panels.title: Station Distribution
panels.description: Total play count per station (persisted across app restarts)

panels.title: AI Tool Calls
panels.description: Total AI function calls in selected time range

panels.title: MQTT Commands
panels.description: Total MQTT commands received in selected time range

panels.title: OpenHAB Requests
panels.description: REST API calls to OpenHAB by method and status in selected time range

panels.title: OpenHAB Item Changes
panels.description: Smart home item state changes in selected time range

panels.title: TV Commands
panels.description: Total TV commands in selected time range

panels.title: MPD Reconnections
panels.description: Error-triggered reconnects to the MPD server — elevated count indicates network instability

panels.title: Token Usage Over Time
panels.description: Input and output tokens consumed per interval

panels.title: Input Tokens
panels.description: Total input (prompt) tokens consumed in selected time range

panels.title: Output Tokens
panels.description: Total output (response) tokens consumed in selected time range

panels.title: Avg Tokens / Session
panels.description: Average total tokens (input + output) per closed session in selected time range
